headline: Generate Biomedicines reports AI-assisted design of a compact CAR signaling domain
summary: Generate Biomedicines’ Oct 27 technical report describes iterative AI-assisted redesign of CAR intracellular domains. It reports that a 45-amino-acid design, krgr–ζ1–40, retained antigen-dependent signaling and improved receptor expression and selected cell-assay outcomes relative to the clinical 4-1BB–CD3ζ comparator. Tests covered transient mRNA, lentiviral and targeted lipid-nanoparticle delivery. The work used multiple models and human scientific iteration; these company-authored in-vitro findings do not establish animal efficacy, clinical benefit or a Claude-only contribution.
